result.title: Video recordings and play behaviour annotations of group-housed dairy calves on two Dutch farms
result.summary: Play is used as an indicator of positive welfare in dairy calves, but openly available video of group-housed calves with individual behaviour annotations is scarce. We describe video from four camera deployments of about one week each in group pens of dairy calves on two farms in the Netherlands: a research and teaching dairy farm (2024 and 2025) and a commercial dairy farm (2024). The recordings comprise 1,173 video files spanning 651 h. For eight observation days, trained observers coded calf behaviour continuously in Noldus The Observer XT with an 18-item ethogram of play and other behaviours, covering 104 h of video, 90 h of which have every calf in the pen coded. The release also contains 1.1 million decoded frames from seven annotated sessions, a per-frame timestamp read by optical character recognition from the camera clock burned into each frame, per-calf segmentation tracks and per-calf frame-level play labels. The data support studies of calf behaviour and welfare and the development and evaluation of automated behaviour recognition.

AI.brief_summary: 该文发布两个荷兰奶牛场群养犊牛的约651小时视频，并附带人工行为标注、分割轨迹与逐帧玩耍标签，用于犊牛行为与福利研究及自动行为识别评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是动物行为标注数据集，不涉及视觉推理中的内部状态、证据筛选或停止决策；自动行为识别仅为逐帧判别任务，缺乏可供核查的 LVR 方法线索。
